              val rcookieVal = json.get("rcookie")?.asString ?: ""
372:                         if (rcookieVal.isNotEmpty()) {
373:                             relayAuthCookie = rcookieVal
374:                         }
375:                         if (cookieVal.isNotEmpty()) {
376:                             userAuthCookie = cookieVal
377:                         }
378:                     }
379:                     if (action == "userinfo") {
380:                         val info = json.getAsJsonObject("userinfo")
381:                         if (info != null) {
382:                             val user = gson.fromJson(info, UserInfo::class.java)
383:                             _userInfo.value = user
384:                             controlRetries.reset()
636:         pingJob = null
637:     }
638: 
639:     private fun startNodePollLoop() {
640:         stopNodePollLoop()
641:         nodePollJob = launchControlWork { webSocket ->
642:             while (true) {
643:                 delay(10000)
644:                 if (_connectionState.value && webSocket != null) {
645:                     webSocket?.send("""{"action":"nodes"}""")
646:                     webSocket?.send("""{"action":"meshes"}""")
647:                 }
648:             }
649:         }
650:     }
651: 
652:     private fun stopNodePollLoop() {
653:         nodePollJob?.cancel()
654:         nodePollJob = null
655:     }
656: 
657:     fun sendClipboardRequest(nodeId: String) {
658:         if (webSocket == null) return
659:         val fullNodeId = if (!nodeId.startsWith("node//")) "node//" + nodeId.removePrefix("node/") else nodeId
660: 
661:         val msg1 = JsonObject().apply {
662:             addProperty("action", "msg")
663:             addProperty("type", "getclip")
664:             addProperty("nodeid", fullNodeId)
665:         }
666:         val msg2 = JsonObject().apply {
667:             addProperty("action", "getclip")
668:             addProperty("nodeid", fullNodeId)
669:         }
670:         val msg3 = JsonObject().apply {
671:             addProperty("action", "getclip")
672:         }
673:         val msg4 = JsonObject().apply {
674:             addProperty("action", "msg")
675:             addProperty("type", "getclipboard")
676:             addProperty("nodeid", fullNodeId)
677:         }
678:         try {
679:             webSocket?.send(msg1.toString())
680:             webSocket?.send(msg2.toString())
681:             webSocket?.send(msg3.toString())
682:             webSocket?.send(msg4.toString())
683:             Log.d("MeshCentralClient", "Sent getclip requests via control socket to $fullNodeId")
684:         } catch (e: Exception) {
685:             Log.e("MeshCentralClient", "Error sending getclip request: ${e.message}")
686:         }
687:     }
688: 
689:     fun sendClipboardText(nodeId: String, text: String) {
690:         if (webSocket == null) return
691:         val fullNodeId = if (!nodeId.startsWith("node//")) "node//" + nodeId.removePrefix("node/") else nodeId
692: 
693:         val msg1 = JsonObject().apply {
694:             addProperty("action", "msg")
695:             addProperty("type", "setclip")
696:             addProperty("nodeid", fullNodeId)
697:             addProperty("data", text)
698:         }
699:         val msg2 = JsonObject().apply {
700:             addProperty("action", "setclip")
701:             addProperty("nodeid", fullNodeId)
702:             addProperty("data", text)
703:         }
704:         val msg3 = JsonObject().apply {
705:             addProperty("action", "setclip")
706:             addProperty("data", text)
707:         }
708:         val msg4 = JsonObject().apply {
718:             webSocket?.send(msg4.toString())
719:             Log.d("MeshCentralClient", "Sent setclip text via control socket to $fullNodeId: '$text'")
720:         } catch (e: Exception) {
721:             Log.e("MeshCentralClient", "Error sending setclip text: ${e.message}")
722:         }
723:     }
724: 
725:     fun hasActiveSessions(): Boolean {
726:         return _connectionState.value && webSocket != null
727:     }
728: 
729:     fun onNetworkChanged() {
730:         controlGeneration.locked {
731:             if(isUserLogout) return
732:             controlGeneration.advance()
733:             controlConnecting=false
734:             controlTimeout?.cancel()
735:             controlTimeout=null
736:             cancelControlWork()
737:             stopPingLoop()
738:             stopNo
